aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab builds software for food trucks and mobile catering: online orders, collection time and fewer repeated questions. Founded by Dominic Bonini.
aboutPage.meta.title: About us — HatchGrab
aboutPage.story.build: We build practical software designed specifically for food trucks and mobile catering, which helps them take online orders, manage collection times, keep orders flowing and lose less time answering repetitive questions.
aboutPage.story.change: HatchGrab was created to change that.
aboutPage.story.fixedAddress: Even so, much of the software available to them is designed for businesses with a fixed address.
aboutPage.story.focus: Our aim is simple: make running a food truck easier, with tools designed for the way these businesses really work.
aboutPage.story.start: HatchGrab was born from a simple observation: food trucks need better tools to run their business.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: After creating Village Foodie, a directory that helps people discover the food trucks visiting their area, I spent more time learning about the challenges of mobile food businesses. Unlike traditional restaurants, food trucks move constantly, work in different places and serve customers in changing conditions.

comparison.faq.capacityA: Customers only see collection times your kitchen can really meet. The system works from each dish’s preparation time and how many you prepare at once.
comparison.faq.capacityQ: How does the system stop my kitchen being overloaded?
comparison.faq.costA: {plans}. Online card payments also carry the fees Stripe charges: {cardFee} per card payment.
comparison.faq.costQ: How much does HatchGrab cost in {country}?
comparison.faq.costTrial: {months, plural, one {The first month is free} other {The first # months are free}}, with every feature.
comparison.faq.locationsA: Yes. You set up your weekly schedule with places and times, and customers order for the place and day you are there.
comparison.faq.locationsQ: Does it work with changing places?
comparison.faq.paymentsA: Customers pay online by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay, or pay on collection at the food truck. PayPal and Klarna are not supported right now.
comparison.faq.paymentsQ: Which payment methods does HatchGrab support?
comparison.faq.termA: No. There is no minimum term and no notice period. You can cancel whenever you want; the fee is billed monthly in advance and you keep access until the end of the month you have paid for.
comparison.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
comparison.faq.tseA: HatchGrab is not a till and has no TSE. How you record online orders in your till is a question for your tax adviser.
comparison.faq.tseQ: Do I still need a till with a TSE?
comparison.faq.whatA: An ordering system takes orders online before customers reach the food truck: they choose dishes and a collection time, pay online or on collection, and the order appears in your kitchen. A till or card reader takes payment at the food truck. The two complement each other.

featuresPage.detail.accountant_reports: Sales, taxes and refunds for any month, quarter or tax year, ready to download for your accountant.
featuresPage.detail.advance_preordering: Let customers order for a future date or time, before the event.
featuresPage.detail.auto_accept: Online orders are accepted automatically: no need to confirm them one by one.
featuresPage.detail.branded_qr_code: Add your logo to the QR code.
featuresPage.detail.buzzer_tracking: Assign a buzzer number to the order when you hand one out, and you’ll know which buzzer goes with each order.
featuresPage.detail.customer_display: A screen visible to customers that shows order numbers and when they’re ready.
featuresPage.detail.discovery_map_listin: Your food truck appears on the public HatchGrab map so customers in the area can find you.
featuresPage.detail.documents_reminders: Save your certificates in one place, such as food hygiene, insurance and gas safety. We remind you before anything expires and you can send them to an event or market organiser with a single tap.
featuresPage.detail.embed_schedule: Show your upcoming dates on your own website. Each one links straight to its ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create your own event types, with custom prices and settings for events and festivals.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The fullest way to use HatchGrab: a live kitchen screen and the only way to keep taking orders when you lose coverage.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_capacity: Set how much the kitchen can cook at once and how long it takes. When a slot is full, customers can no longer choose it.
featuresPage.detail.loyalty_stamp_cards: Reward regular customers with digital stamp cards, which are collected and redeemed automatically.
featuresPage.detail.meal_deals_upsells: Group items into meal deals and offer extras at the moment of paying to raise the average order value.
featuresPage.detail.messenger_instagram_: Like WhatsApp auto-replies, for Messenger and Instagram enquiries.
featuresPage.detail.multi_device_kitchen: Use several screens — the counter and the kitchen — all with the same live orders.
featuresPage.detail.multi_user_access: Give each staff member their own access, with the right permissions.
featuresPage.detail.offline_protection: If you lose coverage, online orders pause so customers can’t place orders you won’t see. The iPhone, iPad and Android app lets you keep taking orders offline; the web dashboard needs a connection.
featuresPage.detail.online_payments: Take card payment in advance when customers order online, via Stripe.
featuresPage.detail.preorder_deadline: Set a cut-off time for items that have to be ordered in advance.
featuresPage.detail.private_events: Add private events that don’t show on the map, with their own private ordering link and QR code.
featuresPage.detail.profit_per_event: Add what each dish costs you and see what you really made at each event, not just the takings.
featuresPage.detail.qr_code: A printable QR code that opens your menu and the ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.schedule_import: We fill in your schedule automatically, from your website or from a photo you already post on Facebook. You only need to review and confirm it.
featuresPage.detail.sms_order_alerts: Automatically send customers an SMS when their order is ready.
featuresPage.detail.social_media_posts: Upload your designs: we automatically add the dates, places and times for each week and each event.
featuresPage.detail.sold_out_toggle: Mark any item as sold out with a single tap: customers see it greyed out instantly.
featuresPage.detail.stock_countdown: Set the stock and it counts down as orders come in; when it runs out, the item is marked sold out automatically.
featuresPage.detail.tap_to_pay: Take card payments from a compatible phone, without needing a separate card reader.
featuresPage.detail.ticket_printing: Print order tickets on a Bluetooth or wired printer in the kitchen.
featuresPage.detail.time_slot_selection: Customers pick a collection time slot and demand is spread across the service.
featuresPage.detail.walkup_orders: Take and manage walk-up orders at the food truck, paid on your own card reader.
featuresPage.detail.web_dashboard: Run the service from the browser of any phone, tablet or laptop.
featuresPage.detail.whatsapp_auto_replie: Automatically answer WhatsApp enquiries about your menu and your schedule.

landing.does.capacityBody: Set how much you can cook at once and how long it takes you. When a collection time is full, customers can no longer choose it.
landing.does.devicesBody: Runs on the phone you carry in your apron, the tablet on the counter, the laptop in the vehicle — and the card machine you already take payment with.
landing.does.lede: Most ordering systems take for granted a fixed address, reliable wifi and the same hours every week. You change place every week, at different times, with little or no mobile coverage. HatchGrab was created for that.
landing.does.offlineBody: If you lose coverage, online orders pause automatically so customers can’t place orders you won’t see. Keep taking orders with the iPhone, iPad and Android app.
landing.does.postsBody: Upload the design you already post on Facebook or Instagram. We put in the dates, places and times, ready to share — every week or every day.
landing.does.postsTitle: Automate your Facebook and Instagram posts
